headword: {同族経営|どうぞくけいえい}

definitions.explanation: A form of corporate management in which the founding family or their relatives hold controlling positions and ownership. Common in both small businesses and large corporations in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同族経営|どうぞくけいえい}だ。

examples.english: Family management has both good and bad aspects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同族経営|どうぞくけいえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Among Japan's long-established businesses, many continue as family-run enterprises.

notes:
A compound of {同族|どうぞく} (same clan/family) and ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧ (management, business operation). Refers to businesses where the founding family retains control through ownership and key management positions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同族経営|どうぞくけいえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: family-run company
- {同族経営|どうぞくけいえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue family management
- {同族経営|どうぞくけいえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題点|もんだいてん}→問題点：20619_mondaiten⟧: problems of family management
- {同族経営|どうぞくけいえい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{脱却|だっきゃく}→脱却：13944_dakkyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to break away from family management

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many of Japan's largest corporations, including Toyota, Suntory, and numerous ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧ (long-established businesses), are or were {同族経営|どうぞくけいえい}. Japanese business culture has a strong tradition of family succession, though modern corporate governance reforms have pushed for more professional management.
